apiKeyReference.hint: Store the API key in your environment or secret store. Enter its reference here, such as env:SERVICE_API_KEY.
apiKeyReference.label: API key reference

defaultPermission.hint: Changing this sets every assistant action below to the same choice.
defaultPermission.label: Manage all permissions

assistant.hint: These choices control assistant actions for this integration. They do not grant access to the provider or replace your application's permissions.

callbackUrlReference.hint: Reference the callback route implemented by your application and registered with the provider.
callbackUrlReference.label: Callback URL reference

clientSecretReference.hint: Use an environment reference such as env:{prefix}_CLIENT_SECRET. Keep the value outside this file.
clientSecretReference.label: Client secret reference

permissions.hint: Choose what the application needs. The account owner approves these permissions when connecting.

serviceAccountReference.hint: Store the service credential in your environment or secret store and enter its reference here.
serviceAccountReference.label: Service-account credential reference
